SERVER_PORT.label: Server listen port
SERVER_PORT.description: TCP port the server listens for HTTP requests on.

BASE_URL.label: Public base URL
BASE_URL.description: Root URL used to generate absolute links and authentication redirects.

TLS_ENABLED.label: HTTPS / TLS enabled
TLS_ENABLED.description: Whether the application is served directly behind a TLS termination.

DEMO_MODE.label: Demo mode
DEMO_MODE.description: Disables every outbound network call (probes, git, proxmox). Only changeable via ENV.

TZ.label: Timezone
TZ.description: Timezone used for cron schedules and date display.

LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level
LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum severity of messages recorded in the server logs.

LOG_FORMAT.label: Log format
LOG_FORMAT.description: Serialization format for application logs (json for containers, text for debugging).

TRUSTED_PROXIES.label: Trusted proxies (CIDRs)
TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated list of IP ranges / reverse proxies allowed to relay X-Forwarded-For headers.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.label: Allowed WebSocket origins (CORS)
ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: List of web origins allowed to connect to the live WebSocket stream.

DB_HOST.label: Database host
DB_HOST.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB server.

DB_PORT.label: Database port
DB_PORT.description: TCP port of the PostgreSQL service.

DB_USER.label: Database user
DB_USER.description: Login used to connect to the database server.

DB_PASSWORD.label: Database password
DB_PASSWORD.description: Password associated with the PostgreSQL user.

DB_SSLMODE.label: Database SSL mode
DB_SSLMODE.description: SSL encryption mode for the PostgreSQL connection.

JWT_SECRET.label: JWT signing secret
JWT_SECRET.description: Secret cryptographic key used to sign JWT access tokens (32 characters minimum).

JWT_EXPIRATION.label: JWT token lifetime
JWT_EXPIRATION.description: How long a user session stays valid before renewal.

REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRATION.label: Refresh token lifetime
REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRATION.description: Maximum duration before a full re-login is required (7 days by default).

ADMIN_USER.label: Default administrator username
ADMIN_USER.description: Name of the initial administrator account created on first startup.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.label: Initial administrator password
ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Temporary password for bootstrapping the admin account (optional if set at boot).

RATE_LIMIT_RPS.label: Global rate limit (RPS)
RATE_LIMIT_RPS.description: Maximum number of requests per second allowed per IP.

RATE_LIMIT_BURST.label: Request burst capacity
RATE_LIMIT_BURST.description: Peak request burst allowed above the standard limit.

OIDC_ENABLED.label: Enable OpenID Connect / SSO
OIDC_ENABLED.description: Enables enterprise single sign-on via an OIDC identity provider.

OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME.label: OIDC provider display name
OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME.description: Text shown on the login page's sign-in button.

OIDC_ISSUER_URL.label: OIDC issuer URL
OIDC_ISSUER_URL.description: Root URL of the OIDC identity provider (e.g. https://auth.example.com).

OIDC_CLIENT_ID.label: OIDC client ID
OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID provided by your OIDC identity server.

OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.label: OIDC client secret
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Shared secret for the OIDC client.

OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM.label: Username claim
OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM.description: ID token field to use as the username.

OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM.label: Email claim
OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM.description: ID token field containing the email address.

OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM.label: Groups claim
OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: Token field containing the user's list of groups.

OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE.label: Default OIDC role
OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE.description: Role assigned to a user with no matching group.

OIDC_AUTO_CREATE_USER.label: Automatic account creation
OIDC_AUTO_CREATE_USER.description: Automatically create a local account on a user's first successful OIDC login.

OIDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_LOGIN.label: Allow local authentication
OIDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_LOGIN.description: Keeps the classic login/password form active even when OIDC is enabled.

OIDC_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.label: Skip OIDC SSL verification
OIDC_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.description: Disables TLS certificate verification for the OIDC issuer (not recommended in production).

NOTIFY_URL.label: ntfy.sh topic URL
NOTIFY_URL.description: Full ntfy topic URL for instant push alerts (e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-server).

NTFY_AUTH_TOKEN.label: ntfy authentication token
NTFY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional access token for private ntfy topics.

SMTP_HOST.label: SMTP host
SMTP_HOST.description: Outgoing mail server address for sending alert emails.

SMTP_PORT.label: SMTP port
SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP connection port (typically 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SMTPS).

SMTP_USER.label: SMTP user
SMTP_USER.description: Authentication login for the SMTP server.

SMTP_PASS.label: SMTP password
SMTP_PASS.description: Password for the SMTP account used to send emails.

SMTP_FROM.label: Sender address (From)
SMTP_FROM.description: Address shown as the sender of email notifications.

SMTP_TO.label: Default recipient address (To)
SMTP_TO.description: Address that receives alerts and reports by email by default.

SMTP_TLS.label: Enable TLS for SMTP
SMTP_TLS.description: Encrypts the SMTP connection via STARTTLS or direct TLS.

GITHUB_TOKEN.label: GitHub personal access token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token for watching new releases and avoiding public API rate limiting.

GITHUB_POLL_INTERVAL.label: GitHub polling interval
GITHUB_POLL_INTERVAL.description: How often remote GitHub releases and tags are checked.

DOCKER_IMAGE_POLL_INTERVAL.label: Docker image polling interval
DOCKER_IMAGE_POLL_INTERVAL.description: How often new container digests are checked on remote registries.

METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Metrics retention (days)
METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Number of days metric time series are kept.

AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Audit log retention (days)
AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How long security audit and administration action traces are kept.

WEB_LOGS_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Web access log retention (days)
WEB_LOGS_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How long captured HTTP requests are kept for traffic and security analysis.

NETWORK_FLOWS_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Network flow retention (days)
NETWORK_FLOWS_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How long network connection metrics (top talkers) are kept.

THREAT_WEIGHT_WORDPRESS.label: WordPress scan weight
THREAT_WEIGHT_WORDPRESS.description: Weight assigned to probes targeting wp-login, xmlrpc or other WordPress paths.

THREAT_WEIGHT_ADMIN_PANEL.label: Admin panel weight
THREAT_WEIGHT_ADMIN_PANEL.description: Weight of unauthorized attempts to access administrative interfaces.

THREAT_WEIGHT_PATH_TRAVERSAL.label: Path traversal weight
THREAT_WEIGHT_PATH_TRAVERSAL.description: Weight of requests containing ../ or other path-escape patterns.

THREAT_WEIGHT_KNOWN_SCANNER.label: Known scanner weight
THREAT_WEIGHT_KNOWN_SCANNER.description: Weight of User-Agents identified as vulnerability scanning tools.

THREAT_WEIGHT_SUSPICIOUS_METHOD.label: Suspicious HTTP method weight
THREAT_WEIGHT_SUSPICIOUS_METHOD.description: Weight of unusual or dangerous HTTP methods (CONNECT, PROPFIND, etc.).

THREAT_THRESHOLD_MEDIUM.label: Threat threshold: Medium
THREAT_THRESHOLD_MEDIUM.description: Total score above which an IP address is classified as a medium threat.

THREAT_THRESHOLD_HIGH.label: Threat threshold: High
THREAT_THRESHOLD_HIGH.description: Total score above which an IP address is classified as a high threat.

THREAT_THRESHOLD_CRITICAL.label: Threat threshold: Critical
THREAT_THRESHOLD_CRITICAL.description: Total score above which an IP address is classified as a critical threat.
